mapper.select: SELECT h.id,h.user_id,h.room_id,h.browse_time,r.room_number,r.rent,a.name apartment_name,a.city_name,a.district_name,a.province_name FROM browsing_history h JOIN room_info r ON r.id=h.room_id AND r.is_deleted=0 AND r.is_release=1 JOIN apartment_info a ON a.id=r.apartment_id AND a.is_deleted=0 AND a.is_release=1 WHERE h.is_deleted=0 AND h.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY h.browse_time DESC,h.id DESC
